Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: There is no God but Me, the All-Compelling, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise...Verily there is no God but Me, the Mighty, the Generous

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Andalib! We counsel thee with that whereby thy station shall be exalted and the fragrance of thy love shall be wafted abroad... One such as thee must arise to reform the world, turning unto Him.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: In most of the Tablets We have commanded all the friends to unity and harmony... All must gird up the loins of service and remove estrangements and differences from among themselves.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: and the faces of those who turned away from the Most Glorious Horizon were darkened... woe unto the heedless

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee...Thou art verily the All-Forgiving, and Thou art verily the Kind, and Thou art verily the Most Merciful, and Thou art verily the Compassionate. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Generous, the All-Bountiful, the Most Gracious.

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: So always supplicate and implore at God's threshold, and ask God to create the means of fellowship and to assist and confirm you so that you may fulfill this task, lift this heavy burden, and endure every hardship and difficulty on this path.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: through which all things were humbled... Verily, Thou art the One Who hath power over whatsoever Thou willest

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Book hath testified to the All-Mighty, the All-Bountiful...He, verily, is the All-Forgiving, the All-Loving.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: when the Sovereign of the Realm of Might came with a name whereby all in the heavens and earth were thunderstruck...whereby the idols were shaken and the pillars of false gods were scattered and every lofty mountain was crushed.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the soul whose hearing hath been blessed with the ability to hearken and whose sight hath been honored to witness these days... Blessed are they that have attained, and joy be to them that are steadfast.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Akhtar! Your plea hath been heard in the Most Great Scene by the Lord of Power. The sweet fragrances of love were inhaled therefrom...That which flowed from the tongue of love in praise and glorification of the Wronged One hath appeared and been made manifest.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This is a Book which the All-Merciful hath sent down unto him who hath turned and attained unto the lights of the Kingdom...Blessed is the tongue that hath spoken in praise of God, and the face that hath turned toward Him, and the heart that hath turned to His luminous horizon.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I beseech Thee...to make me one of those whom the clamor of the people hath not prevented from turning unto Thee

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having awakened me through the breathings of Thy Revelation, made known to me Thy ancient bounty, and shown me Thy wondrous generosity. I beseech Thee...to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In the days when the foundations of all were disturbed and shaken through the power of oppression... Then souls who were fearful, agitated and concealed behind a veil came forth with the sword of rejection and made for the truth. The curse of God be upon the wrong-doing people! Now they strive and struggle to lead the weak astray.

Subject: sacrifice of self; mystery of sacrifice
Quotation: Perhaps you may reach the point of having to sacrifice your lives and spend your wealth on this path. Anyone whose aim is lofty must make every difficulty acceptable to themselves

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: With complete love and affection arose to serve the Lord of all beings...Her remembrance hath ever been before the Wronged One, Who testifieth to her turning, her devotion, her humility, her submissiveness and her service unto God and in His straight path

Subject: soul is the essential reality of man
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/soul is the essential reality of man.txt
Quotation: "The reality of human nature in this physical body is the soul which is the source of life and movement."

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Today those who quaff the choice wine of inner meanings must at all times fix their gaze upon the horizon of the All-Merciful, and with the utmost steadfastness and wisdom bestow the Kawthar of utterance upon the people of possibility.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the Cause through His Name, the Guardian over the worlds... Be thou so firm in the love of God that the croaking of every accursed satan shall not prevent thee.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This is the Day of mention and praise, and the Day of steadfastness and faithfulness...That which is accounted as the most mighty of all deeds in the presence of the Throne this day is steadfastness in this mighty Cause.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This Wronged One arose to promote the Cause of God - an arising after which no sitting down was seen. Night and day did the tongue speak and the pen write... We beseech God that He may aid thee in that which is the cause of the Most Great Steadfastness... Convey My greetings to the friends in those regions and remind them on behalf of God of the Most Great Steadfastness.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: A mention from the Wronged One... in this mighty Prison.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: on a day wherein every learned one turned away, and every mystic denied, and every transgressor pronounced judgment... yet they turned away from Us and cast the Book of God behind their backs and rose up against Us with such tyranny as caused the Concourse on High to lament

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: they who cast the ordinance of God behind their backs and accepted the rule of every remote transgressor... they have turned away from the Dayspring of My countenance and the Dawning-Place of My verses, and have followed him who hath cited My words which We sent down aforetime unto Muhammad, the Apostle of God, and who hath arisen in opposition in such wise as hath caused all things to lament

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Yet you must make every hardship and difficulty acceptable to yourselves, for the aim is great. That is, you must resist all humanity, for all nations think of war and believe they should plunder one another and conquer countries. Certainly this work of yours is very difficult, but if you strive and do not grow weary, if you expend your efforts, beneficial results will follow.

Subject: thankfulness; gratitude
Quotation: Give thanks unto thy Lord for this supreme bounty. Say: Praise be to Thee...Praise be to Thee, O Goal of the mystics!

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book which the All-Merciful hath sent down...whose fragrance shall never cease throughout the eternity of His most excellent names. To this doth My Most Exalted Pen testify in this wondrous Tablet.

Subject: transcendence; unknowability of God
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God of Names and Creator of heaven... O God of existence and Lord of the seen and unseen

Subject: transcendence; unknowability of God
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O Thou through Whose Name all created things were dissolved, by Whose command all contingent beings were subdued... Thou hast ever been, O my God, supreme over all who are in Thy earth and sanctified above all that are with Thy creation.

Subject: transcendence; unknowability of God
Quotation: Through Thy revelation of Thyself have I known Thee, that Thou canst not be known through aught else but Thee. Through Thy creation of all things from nothing have I known Thee, that none can attain unto knowledge of Thine essence.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: God created humans to be the manifestation of human virtues, to be the cause of comfort and ease in the world, to be the cause of love and fellowship - not to be predatory animals shedding each other's blood, plundering each other's property, seizing land from one another. God desires humans to be angelic, illumined, just, fair, not transgressing, helping one another, so that perfect kindness may be achieved among humanity.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Today I read about the events in Italy and Turkey. A new war has broken out and the blood of poor humans is being shed for the basest of things. They kill each other for this black earth, even though it belongs to none of them.

Subject: wisdom [hikmat]
Quotation: We counsel thee and those who have believed to observe wisdom... Hold thou fast unto the cord of wisdom in all conditions
